clock_evidence.implementation: libsyscall/wrappers/mach_absolute_time.s ARM64 lines240-260: shared CNTVCT_EL0 plus commpage offset, retry if offset changes
clock_evidence.conversion: elapsed_ns = delta_ticks * numer / denom, using overflow-safe wide arithmetic and nonzero denominator
clock_evidence.comparability: Same running guest boot UUID and timebase; this is a common guest clock, not per-process CPU usage. Reject mixed boot UUIDs. Retain raw ticks and both process identities.
limitations: Guest ticks are not host monotonic timestamps; retain host monotonic request/receipt/capture separately.
TCG scheduling, host load, suspension and timekeeping configuration affect interpretation. Do not label these physical-device performance measurements.
mach_absolute_time differs from continuous time across sleep; do not include guest sleep/suspend in a launch trial.

capture_plan.point: Immediately before existing original LS open call, after registration/proxy preparation; no NSLog/TCP between stamp and call.
First callback instruction; record accepted/error separately. This is service acknowledgement, not visibility.

instrumentation: Fixed-size in-memory raw timestamp records only in measured hooks. Defer existing marker/network/file/NSLog work until both relevant appeared and active hooks have been captured for initial launch; bounded failure handling later. Current synchronous marker sends before UIApplicationMain and in hooks would contaminate timings if retained there. A main-to-active measurement excludes pre-main dyld/runtime work; launcher-request-to-main includes those plus IPC/scheduling.
trial_identity: Current boot UUID, exact app executable/UID, PID plus independently observed process incarnation where available, per-trial identifier, event sequence and raw ticks. One outstanding request at a time. Preserve transport claim-PID verification caveat: not peer authentication.

definitions.process_cold: Verify prior owned process exits/absent, then normal original open request yields fresh main and process incarnation. Does not clear dyld/filesystem caches.
definitions.warm_foreground: Use ordinary Home/background UI, verify same process survives, then existing original open request. Measure next active hook; no main required and viewDidAppear may not repeat.
definitions.boot_cold: Separate whole-VM restart experiment; report boot/setup state and cannot equate with cleared storage caches.
definitions.visual: Host before/after captures and actual counter interaction remain proof of visible functionality, not precise frame-presentation latency.

termination.candidate: Normal SIGTERM to exact positive owned PID after path, UID and process-incarnation revalidation; never process-group/broadcast signals.
termination.original_policy: bsd/kern/kern_sig.c cansignal lines376-384 checks mac_proc_check_signal before cansignal_nomac root rule lines305-320; kill positive-PID path lines1535-1570 returns EPERM on denial and can return success for a zombie.
termination.required_execution_evidence: Record return/errno, then bounded process-state observation proving original incarnation exited before opening again. Signal acceptance alone is insufficient. PID revalidation has a residual race; do not describe it as atomic authorization. No automatic SIGKILL or entitlement escalation.
termination.relaunch: Existing actual-executed LSApplicationWorkspace openApplicationWithBundleIdentifier:configuration:completionHandler: with nil configuration, exact owned bundle.
termination.alternative_not_selected: Original FBSSystemService terminateApplication:forReason:andReport:withDescription:completion: exists at0x1860ebd8c; server _handleTerminateApplication:forClient: at0x18de32dac. Complete authorization contract not established, so do not introduce it based on method existence.
